POS packages

Retail & supermarket

Frequently asked questions

Do you sell POS machines with software?

Yes. We supply complete POS systems — the hardware with our SELLO software installed and set up.

Do you install and train staff?

Yes. Every POS package includes installation, product and tax setup, staff training and support.

Can I use my existing computer or printer?

Often, yes. SELLO runs in the browser on most devices on your shop network; we check your equipment first.

How much does a POS machine cost?

It depends on the devices and number of counters you need. Message us on WhatsApp for a quote for your shop.
